title: Flag symbol moon recognition and expanded symbol templates
body:
- Mapped "moon" and "crescent moon" (and Polish "księżyc") to the crescent flag symbol, resolving questions about flags featuring moons (e.g. Uzbekistan, Turkey, Algeria) deterministically.
- Added comprehensive flag symbol question skeletons across game modes.
- Added crescent flag symbol for Mongolia.
- Your saved game progress, daily streaks, and normal game limits are unchanged.
